C1376.title: BitFloor Exchange Loses 24,000 BTC Due to Unencrypted Wallet Key Backup
C1376.summary: In May 2012, hackers attacked the BitFloor exchange and stole 24,000 bitcoins. The root cause was an unencrypted backup of wallet keys, which allowed the attackers to easily obtain the keys and steal the massive crypto assets, ultimately leading to the exchange's closure.
